title_zh: 更正人体模型中贴错的标签

scenario.goal_zh: 为生物课展示核实模型部位及图片标签。

context_zh: 生物课上，学生埃拉与老师佩雷斯核对供展示的模型及图片标签。
author: author-phase08-b

sentences.speaker: Ella
sentences.text: I put this label on the lung, but the worksheet says it belongs to a nerve.

sentences.speaker: Ms Perez
sentences.text: You're looking at two different pictures. The large chest model goes with page one; the detail of the arm goes with page two.

sentences.speaker: Ella
sentences.text: So the thin yellow line in the arm picture is the part the label refers to?

sentences.speaker: Ms Perez
sentences.text: Yes, according to the key on that worksheet. Keep the lung label with the chest model.

sentences.speaker: Ella
sentences.text: I've moved the label to the arm picture and put the page numbers underneath both images.

sentences.speaker: Ms Perez
sentences.text: That makes the display much clearer. Now each label points to the intended part.
